title: The RNA content of human sperm reflects prior events in spermatogenesis and potential post-fertilization effects.
authors: Corral-Vazquez, C; Blanco, J; Aiese Cigliano, R; Sarrate, Z; Rivera-Egea, R; Vidal, F; Garrido, N; Daub, C; Anton, E
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA-seq分析人类精子mRNA和lncRNA表达谱，聚焦精子转录组与精子发生及胚胎发育关联，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Transcriptome analyses using high-throughput methodologies allow a deeper understanding of biological functions in different cell types/tissues. The present study provides an RNA-seq profiling of human sperm mRNAs and lncRNAs (messenger and long non-coding RNAs) in a well-characterized population of fertile individuals. Sperm RNA was extracted from twelve ejaculate samples under strict quality controls. Poly(A)-transcripts were sequenced and aligned to the human genome. mRNAs and lncRNAs were classified according to their mean expression values (FPKM: Fragments Per Kilobase of transcript per Million mapped reads) and integrity. Gene Ontology analysis of the Expressed and Highly Expressed mRNAs showed an involvement in diverse reproduction processes, while the Ubiquitously Expressed and Highly Stable mRNAs were mainly involved in spermatogenesis. Transcription factor enrichment analyses revealed that the Highly Expressed and Ubiquitously Expressed sperm mRNAs were primarily regulated by zinc-fingers and spermatogenesis-related proteins. Regarding the Expressed lncRNAs, only one-third of their potential targets corresponded to Expressed mRNAs and were enriched in cell-cycle regulation processes. The remaining two-thirds were absent in sperm and were enriched in embryogenesis-related processes. A significant amount of post-testicular sperm mRNAs and lncRNAs was also detected. Even though our study is solely directed to the poly-A fraction of sperm transcripts, results indicate that both sperm mRNAs and lncRNAs constitute a footprint of previous spermatogenesis events and are configured to affect the first stages of embryo development.
abstract_zh: 利用高通量方法进行的转录组分析能够更深入地理解不同细胞类型/组织中的生物学功能。本研究提供了在特征明确的可育个体群体中人类精子mRNA和lncRNA（信使RNA和长链非编码RNA）的RNA-seq图谱。在严格质量控制下，从十二份精液样本中提取了精子RNA。对Poly(A)-转录本进行了测序，并比对到人类基因组。根据平均表达值（FPKM：每百万映射读段中每千碱基转录本的片段数）和完整性，对mRNA和lncRNA进行了分类。对表达和高度表达的mRNA进行的基因本体论分析显示，它们参与了多种生殖过程，而普遍表达且高度稳定的mRNA主要涉及精子发生。转录因子富集分析揭示，高度表达和普遍表达的精子mRNA主要受锌指蛋白和精子发生相关蛋白的调控。关于表达的lncRNA，其潜在靶标中仅有三分之一对应于表达的mRNA，并富集于细胞周期调控过程。其余三分之二在精子中缺失，并富集于胚胎发生相关过程。还检测到了大量睾丸后精子mRNA和lncRNA。尽管我们的研究仅针对精子转录本的poly-A部分，但结果表明，精子mRNA和lncRNA共同构成了先前精子发生事件的足迹，并配置为影响胚胎发育的早期阶段。
